tagline: Good writing is clear thinking, made visible on the page.

benefits.title: Writing that sounds like you, only sharper
benefits.sub: Built for people who write every day and want the draft to feel finished.

items.title: Drafts in your voice
items.text: Paste a few lines you wrote and Penwise matches your tone, so the draft reads like you on a good day.

items.title: Edit with one pass
items.text: Tighten long sentences, fix grammar and cut repetition, without losing the meaning.

items.title: Tone control
items.text: Switch between friendly, formal and concise and see the same idea rewritten for each reader.

items.title: Works where you write
items.text: Use it in docs, email and the web, with your drafts saved on your device.

how.title: From rough note to finished draft in three steps

steps.title: Describe what you need
steps.text: Paste a rough note or write one sentence about the message.

steps.title: Pick a tone and length
steps.text: Choose friendly, formal or concise, and how long the result should be.

steps.title: Copy a polished draft
steps.text: Review the rewrite, copy it, and paste it where it belongs.

demo.empty: Choose a tone and press rewrite to see the polished version.

samples.label: Work email
samples.before: Hi team, just wanted to say the report is late because we had some problems with the data and I will send it soon, sorry about that.
samples.friendly: Hi team, quick update: the report is running a little late while we fix a data issue. I will share it with you as soon as it is ready, and thank you for your patience.
samples.formal: Dear team, please note the report will arrive later than planned while we resolve a data issue. I will share it as soon as it is ready. Thank you for your understanding.
samples.concise: Team update: the report is delayed by a data issue. I will send it as soon as it is ready.

samples.label: Report intro
samples.before: This report talks about sales in the last three months and what we did and what we think we should do next.
samples.friendly: This report looks at sales over the past three months, what worked, and what we plan to do next.
samples.formal: This report reviews sales performance over the past three months and sets out recommended next steps.
samples.concise: Sales review, past three months: results, lessons, and next steps.

samples.label: Social post
samples.before: We are happy to announce our new feature is now live and we hope you like it please try it and tell us what you think.
samples.friendly: Our new feature is live. Try it out and tell us what you think, we would love to hear from you.
samples.formal: We are pleased to announce our new feature is now available. We invite you to try it and share your feedback.
samples.concise: New feature, now live. Try it and share your thoughts.

Drafts you create in the demo stay in your browser. Account drafts are stored only while you are signed in, and you can delete them at any time.
English and Arabic today, with more languages planned. Tone and style controls work in both.

items.q: Can it match my writing style?
items.a: Yes. Paste a few samples of your own writing and Penwise follows your sentence length, word choice and tone.

items.q: Is my content used to train models?
items.a: No. Content you write is not used for training. See the privacy note in the footer for the full wording.
Yes. You can cancel from your account settings and keep access until the end of the current period.

footer.privacyText: Penwise stores only the account details you provide and the drafts you save. Demo text stays in your browser and is never sent to a server. You can delete your account and drafts at any time.
footer.termsText: Penwise is provided as is for drafting and editing assistance. You own the text you create. Final pricing, limits and availability are confirmed on the pricing page before you pay.
